question: Show only 2023 district immunisation coverage and identify the lowest district. Do not guess a reason.

view.title: District Immunisation Coverage – 2023
view.note: Renderer filters to year 2023. Coverage = children_fully_immunised / children_due. Bars compare districts; the lowest bar is the lowest-coverage district.

interpretation_guard.caveat: Data is a synthetic smoke fixture; no causal explanation is available for why a district has lower coverage.
